messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync 1: ACME wants upgrades where tenant IPs survive and netops involvement is minimal. They asked for a proposal with installer-side hooks + a safe staged rollback path. :thinking_face:

sam (eng): Two approaches: A) installer-side adapter that calls customer IPAM/DNS using narrow creds; B) netops pre-provisioned aliases and our handoff. A lowers customer effort but increases our support scope.

leo (product): If we pick A we must define launch gates and legal scopes. B is lower risk but might lose deals.

rita (field): Field report: large customers with many tenants prefer A for automation. Biggest non-negotiable: preserve external IPs across upgrades so clients don't rebind.

sam (eng): Prototype flow for adapter path: deploy adapter as a k8s Job/DaemonSet. Steps: 1) allocate temporary endpoints, 2) sync KV caches and establish overlapping routing, 3) atomically switch DNS records with health checks. On failure we revert DNS back.

maya (PM): Can you draft a minimal installer config we can show security/legal?

sam (eng): Draft config:
```yaml
adapter:
  name: ip-preserve-adapter
  version: v0.1.0
  credsPath: /var/run/creds/ipam-token
  mode: staged
  preflight: true
  rollbackOnFailure: true
```
Adapter requires token scope: allocate/release records, update A/AAAA, set TTLs.

nate (sre): Observability + SLOs: require /ready, /metrics, and event emit to our logging. Rollout must wait 5m steady-state before DNS swap.

rita (field): Also provide a manual handoff runbook for customers who forbid third-party DNS writes. NetOps-opt-out must be first-class.

leo (product): MVP checklist for decision: adapter binary + helm chart, token auth with least privilege, installer flag --enable-ip-preserve, obs contract (events + metrics), field runbook, legal network-access template.

maya (PM): Commercial impact: 2 enterprise prospects (~$80k ARR each) blocked till we ship (if we choose plugin path it's ~3 sprints including security reviews). Manual handoff is ~1 sprint but risks losing logos.

sam (eng): Risks: matrix of k8s distros, IPAM vendors (Route53, Infoblox), BGP vs NAT setups. Mitigate: ship Route53 adapter + generic HTTP-IPAM shim first, mark others incubating.

nate (sre): Rollback: KV cache serialization must be backward compatible; else fall back to cold-start with graceful drain. Need an eval harness.

maya (PM): Proposed two-phase launch: Phase 1 (MVP) -> Route53 + generic shim, helm chart, obs, legal template. Phase 2 -> Infoblox adapter, BGP preservation, netops opt-out docs.

rita (field): :+1: Field fine with sequencing. Request: pick a pilot customer for Phase 1 in March.

leo (product): I'll propose ACME as pilot pending legal sign-off.

deploy-bot: Reminder: attach installer flag docs to PR and include metrics contract in telemetry spec.

maya (PM): Action items: Sam - sprint estimate for MVP + risk list (due EOD Tue). Nate - observability contract + eval harness criteria (EOD Wed). Leo/Rita - pilot outreach + legal kickoff. I'll add to roadmap and escalate if customers confirm. :rocket:
